Source Discovery prompt modal (radius 24, Shadow/Highest). Left sidebar of nav rows (Suggested / Find prompts / Saved / Shared) plus collapsible Topics / Agent prompts / Source prompts accordions (closed by default, one open at a time) whose sub-rows each load their own prompts with "Suggested by {source}" attribution. Selected rows use a soft grey pill. Reuses the Dialog surface, Menu rows, and Divider.
